Grammer also said he co-founded the educational nonprofit The American Revelation to counteract the damage he believes our education system delivers. The group creates “content and experiences” that help Americans “explore and celebrate the nation’s history, founding principles, and enduring values,” according to the organization’s website . Grammer hopes his project will combat the idea that America is a “c--p country,” which he thinks schools perpetuate. Read more at The Daily Beast.
